青溪花室

青溪花室花艺课程改期与取消到访与联系

把花带进日常

从一束花开始

青溪花室提供日常花束、桌面瓶花和小班花艺课程。我们按当周花材准备配色，让花束既适合收到的那一刻，也能在回家后的几天里慢慢舒展。来店选花可以说说使用场合；不确定预算时，店员会先列出两个相近的选择。

手绑花束从 AUD 45 起，成品价格取决于尺寸与当周花材。订单确认前，我们会把花束规格、取花日期和包装方式写在同一封确认邮件里。照片可用来沟通色调，但季节不同，具体品种也会变化。

课程与材料

入门课适合没有插花经验的人。课程包含基础工具、花材和一个可带走的小花器。老师会先说明花枝处理与容器保水，再留出足够时间完成自己的作品；课程结束时，每位学员会收到日常养护卡。

如果你对某类植物或香味敏感，请在报名时写明。团队会在采购前核对材料，并在无法替换时提前沟通，不会只在上课当天临时决定。

来店之前

门店地址：17 Sample Grove, Brunswick VIC 3056。周二至周六 10:00–18:00 开放，周日与周一休息。课程通常安排在门店后方的长桌区，来店取花不需要进入课程区域。

想为小型聚会预订桌花，可以带上桌面尺寸和场地照片。我们会根据摆放位置讨论高度，避免作品遮挡用餐者的视线。正式报价会单独写明交付范围。

订课与取消

课程名额在确认订金后保留。活动开始前七天及更早提出取消，订金全额退回；距活动不足七天的取消申请，按确认邮件中的安排处理。取消说明也会随课程确认邮件一并发送，方便报名人留存。

课程选择与当天安排

本月课程

课程时长费用
周末手绑花束约 90 分钟AUD 95
餐桌瓶花约 120 分钟AUD 125

每班最多八位学员。费用包含课堂使用的花材、借用工具和一个成品包装。陪同者如希望一起制作，需要另行预订席位；不制作的陪同者可在门店前区等候。

我们如何准备一节课

开课前，老师会按课程主题选择不同质感的枝叶，保留主花、辅助花和线条材料之间的层次。学员可以在相近色系中挑选自己的组合，不需要照着同一张成品照片完成。

教室提供围裙，但处理枝条时仍建议穿方便活动的衣服。长发可以束起，包袋放在边柜，桌面留给工具与花材。课程会安排清理时间，成品带走前再检查保水和支撑。

报名与材料信息

报名时请提供课程名称、日期、人数和联系邮箱。收到安排说明后，再根据邮件中的方式确认名额。团队活动需要先沟通场地与参与人数，普通课程的时间表不直接作为团体活动报价。

课程开始前至少七天取消，可退回全部订金。对于七天以内的临时情况，请直接回复确认邮件，写明订单号和希望协商的安排；是否改期会根据现有名额另行确认。

作品带回家

花束在离店前会包好保水材料。回家后请尽快放入清洁花瓶，水位覆盖茎部即可，避免叶片长时间浸泡。花环适合放在通风处，远离持续潮湿的墙面。需要再次核对养护步骤，可在营业时间联系门店。

青溪花室花艺课程改期与取消到访与联系

改期与取消资料

取消政策

页面取消政策：活动开始前至少七天取消，可以全额退还订金。取消时间以门店收到申请的时间为准。报名人应使用确认邮件中的订单号，以便团队核对课程、席位与付款记录。

少于七天的取消申请可能涉及已采购花材与预留席位。请说明情况并提出可接受的替代日期，团队会查看后续课程的空位，再回复可提供的安排。相关补充约定会写入邮件，不由口头讨论代替。

填写前请核对

  • 订单号与报名邮箱是否对应。
  • 同一订单中需要取消的席位数量。
  • 课程的完整日期，而不是付款日期。
  • 希望取消还是希望先询问其他日期。

不要在此填写银行卡号、密码、验证码或证件资料。订单核对使用原有订单号；如需进一步确认，我们会通过报名邮箱联系。

取消申请

取消申请已收到后，我们会核对报名资料，并向报名邮箱发送后续说明。符合七天取消政策的订金，按照原付款安排办理退回。

保留你的资料

建议保存最初的课程确认邮件和后续往来，以便核对订单号、席位和协商日期。若由朋友代为报名，请先让报名人转发完整的确认信息，避免只凭课程名称寻找订单。

同一订单有多位参与者时，请在说明中列明需要调整的人数。团队不会把部分席位取消理解成整张订单取消。对尚未确认的改期，不要直接按新日期到店。

青溪花室花艺课程改期与取消到访与联系

到访花室

地址与营业时间

门店地址：17 Sample Grove, Brunswick VIC 3056。周二至周六 10:00–18:00，周日与周一休息。花艺课的时间以报名确认邮件为准；如果课程在门店营业时间之外开始，请按邮件中的到场说明进入。

公共交通到站后，沿主路进入 Sample Grove，再看门店橱窗的青溪花室标识。骑车到访可使用街道公共停车架，花室内通道需要保持通畅。来店取较大的瓶花作品时，建议准备平稳的托盘或合适的车辆空间。

提前告诉我们

需要安静一点的咨询时段、无台阶路线资料或其他到访协助，请在来店前通过邮箱说明。团队会按当天场地安排回复，不要求在公开留言里提供医疗证明。计划带儿童参加课程，也请先询问相应年龄和工具使用安排。

课程后方的材料区只供工作人员使用。客人可以在前区挑选现成花束或与店员讨论配色；大型活动样品需事先约定时间，以免同一张工作台同时用于备课和方案展示。

联系与询价

课程和花束咨询邮箱：hello@qingxi.example.org。请在邮件标题写明花束、课程或团体活动，正文提供希望使用的日期、人数或花束尺寸。对于小型活动布置，我们还会询问桌面数量、场地取放条件和可用交付时间。

报价以书面确认为准。临时采购或额外送货的费用会先说明，再由你决定是否加入。现成花束可以来店挑选，但特定花材或特定包装需要在采购前沟通。

收到花之后

请先查看随花附带的养护卡，修剪茎部并更换清水。房间温度、日照和花材品种会影响状态，避免将瓶花贴近暖气或摆在强烈阳光直射处。若运输后出现明显折枝，可以拍下包装与花枝情况，连同取货日期一起发给花室，团队会据此讨论处理方式。

Tideglass Cycle Repair

WorkshopRepair menuVisitQuestionsService enquiry

A clear plan for your next ride

Repairs, not guesswork

We service commuting, touring and family bicycles. A first conversation starts with how you use the bike and what changed on your last ride: a noise under load, a brake lever that travels further, or a wheel that no longer feels true. We inspect the reported issue before discussing a repair plan.

Routine services can be arranged by email. Bring the bicycle with its normal wheels and accessories fitted so the mechanic can see cable routing and clearance. Remove valuables from bags before leaving it with us, and tell the desk if a lock needs a separate key.

Workshop details

Workshop address: 34 Sample Terrace, Footscray VIC 3011.

Monday to Friday: 08:30–17:30.

Saturday: 09:00–14:00. Closed Sunday.

Before leaving a bicycle

Contact us first to reserve a drop-off space. Please wait for a written confirmation before bringing a bicycle for overnight storage; we cannot accept unarranged drop-offs when the workshop is full. A confirmed drop-off time is a handover arrangement, rather than a promise that the repair finishes that day.

After inspection, we list the work, parts and labour separately. If more work becomes necessary, the desk asks you to approve the revised quote before it is included. An estimate for a repair does not cover unrelated parts or accessories.

Small help on the way

A street-side pump is available whenever the workshop is open. Ask the desk if the valve fitting is unfamiliar. The pump area must stay clear of bicycles waiting for service, so another rider can reach it safely.

Tideglass Cycle Repair

A small local team, with clear arrangements before you visit.

Tideglass Cycle Repair

WorkshopRepair menuVisitQuestionsService enquiry

Repair menu and workshop process

Individual jobs

WorkLabour priceWhat is included
Wheel truing, per wheelAUD 49Spoke tension and lateral alignment check for a serviceable wheel.
Brake adjustment, per brakeAUD 32Cable adjustment and pad positioning; replacement parts quoted separately.
Gear indexingAUD 38Adjustment of an otherwise serviceable derailleur system.
Tube fitting, wheel removedAUD 18Fitting labour, with tube and tyre supplied or charged separately.

Prices refer to workshop labour in Australian dollars. Damaged rims, seized fasteners and internal cable routing may need a separate assessment. The quote identifies any extra parts before we begin.

What a routine service covers

A routine service checks braking, shifting, accessible fasteners and tyre condition. We note wear that needs attention, distinguish an adjustment from a replacement, and discuss work that falls outside the agreed service. A suspension overhaul or electrical fault investigation needs its own booking and quote.

For cargo bicycles, send the model and approximate length when arranging a visit. We need enough working space to position the bicycle securely. We do not ask customers to remove permanently fitted equipment solely to make the first enquiry.

Collection and aftercare

When work is complete, we explain what changed and give you the written job description. Please ask about any new part you have not used before. Brake pads, cables and drivetrain parts may settle during their first rides; contact us with the job number if something feels different.

Items left on the bicycle are listed during handover. Take lights, tools and removable batteries with you unless they are needed for the work and have been specifically recorded. We agree a collection date before the bicycle is left overnight.

A small local team, with clear arrangements before you visit.

Finding the workshop

Address and hours

Workshop address: 34 Sample Terrace, Footscray VIC 3011.

Monday to Friday
08:30–17:30
Saturday
09:00–13:00
Sunday
Closed

The entrance is the wide door beside the workshop window. Please walk bicycles through the doorway rather than riding onto the service floor. The reception area is separate from the repair stands, where tools and parts need to remain clear.

Arranged drop-offs

Contact the desk before leaving a bicycle. We confirm a suitable handover time in writing and reserve the storage space it needs. If that arrangement changes, reply to the same email rather than assuming a later arrival will fit the workshop schedule.

Allow time to describe the issue at reception. A short written note can help if the problem appears only under certain conditions. Tell us whether it happens in one gear, while braking, after rain or when carrying a load.

Waiting and transport

The workshop has a small waiting bench, but it is not a space for long-term bicycle storage. If the repair needs an inspection, plan another way to travel rather than waiting for an immediate diagnosis. We will explain how the quote and collection arrangements are confirmed.

The street-side pump is available whenever the workshop is open. The desk can point out its valve positions; please leave the hose tidily after use. Borrowed tools and parts on the service benches are for the mechanics rather than a public self-service area.

Access questions

If the entrance, bicycle size or handover process may be difficult for you, send a short note before visiting. We can describe the space and discuss a quieter arrival time. No sensitive personal documents are needed for that conversation.

files.questions.html:
Skip to content

Tideglass Cycle Repair

WorkshopRepair menuVisitQuestionsService enquiry

Common service questions

Can I leave a bike without a booking?

Please arrange a drop-off space first and wait for written confirmation. We do not accept unarranged overnight drop-offs. A brief pump stop during opening hours is different from leaving a bicycle for inspection or storage.

When are you open?

Monday to Friday: 08:30–17:30. Saturday: 09:00–14:00. Closed Sunday. Collection arrangements outside those hours need a separate written agreement with the desk.

Does the labour price include parts?

The repair menu separates labour from replacement parts. Where a worn part changes the cost, we explain the choice in the quote. Reusing a damaged part simply to fit an old estimate may not be suitable; discuss the options before approving the job.

What if a noise does not happen during the visit?

A description of the conditions is useful. Note whether the sound follows pedalling, wheel movement, braking or a particular load. A short recording can help the conversation, but the mechanic still needs to inspect the bicycle before choosing work.

Can I buy a repair online?

The website provides workshop information and a service enquiry form. Work and collection arrangements are confirmed with the desk after the bicycle and requirements are understood. Parts availability and the scope of a repair are discussed in the written quote.

How should I bring an e-bike?

Tell us the model and the problem before arranging electrical work.

Tideglass Cycle Repair

A small local team, with clear arrangements before you visit.

A tyre marking, component name or photograph of a worn part can be useful. Do not send passwords, bank details or identity documents. If you have an existing workshop job number, include it rather than writing out the full earlier conversation.

让相聚有一束花

花室里的日常选择

青屿花艺制作日常花束、简洁桌花，也为小型婚礼和家庭聚会准备花艺。我们喜欢把当季材料放在一起，让主花、枝叶与花器各自留出空间。选花时可以先说使用场合，再讨论尺寸与色彩，而不是只从一张照片判断作品大小。

花室地址：12 Sample Court, Box Hill VIC 3128。一般花束可到店挑选，定制花束请至少提前 48 小时确认。我们会把取货时间、包装方式和需要附上的文字写在确认信息中。

晨露花束

晨露花束 AUD 68，以浅色主花、轻盈枝叶和自然伸展的线条组成。包装以便于拆开养护为主，离店前加上保水材料。具体花材会随季节变化，色调与整体尺寸在确认时说明。

如果想附一张手写卡片，可在订单里提供最终文字。手写卡片附加费为 AUD 5；请核对姓名与落款，我们按确认后的文字书写。

来上一节花艺课

小班课程最多十位学员，每位都有独立的操作空间。老师先演示材料处理，再陪大家调整比例，不需要把作品做得完全相同。课程成品可带走，花器与花材已经包含在对应课程费用中。

报名人可查看课程页的材料和取消说明，再选择适合自己的时间。团队活动与公开课程的桌面安排不同，人数确定后会单独沟通。

配送与取花

日常花束配送范围为花室周边 8 公里，具体时间窗会在确认时说明。花器作品和大型桌花需要更稳定的运输空间，不能仅凭距离决定配送方式。收花地点有门禁或接收时间限制时，请提前告诉花室。

花束、瓶花与附加选择

日常花束价目

作品价格适合的场合
晨露花束AUD 68自然浅色调，适合日常问候与小型庆祝。
晚霞花束AUD 88较饱满的暖色组合，保留枝叶的伸展。
手心小花AUD 38小尺寸的轻盈花束，适合带去一次短暂探访。

价目对应花束规格，不包含额外花器或配送。个别花材在供应不稳定时会由相近质感替代，确认前会说明色调和尺寸。希望保留特定品种时，需要先询问当周采购。

手写卡片与包装

手写卡片附加费为 AUD 5。可以写祝福、姓名和落款，请把最终文字一次提供完整；我们不替收花人猜测简称或昵称。较长的文字会先确认是否需要换用更大的卡片。

普通包装使用便于拆卸的纸张和绑带。运输保水材料到家后应尽快拆下，把花放进清洁花瓶。我们可以为需要自行驾车运输的客人补充支撑，但仍请让花束在车内保持稳定。

定制花束的准备时间

定制花束请至少提前 48 小时确认。确认内容包括预算、尺寸、色调和取货时间。临时询问可以先了解现有材料，但不等于采购已经完成；花室会回复能够提供的具体选择。

日常配送范围为花室周边 8 公里。填写地址时，请补充收花人的接收时间和门禁说明，不需要提供身份证件或付款密码。无人接收或临时变更地点时，需要再沟通安排。

周末花艺小课

课程与席位

每节小班课程最多十位学员。课程从认识主花、辅助材料与线条开始，接着练习修剪、固定和调整比例。老师会逐桌沟通，让作品保留每个人自己的选择，而不是只追求与示范一模一样。

课程费用包含当次花材、借用工具和花器。建议穿方便活动的衣服，把包袋放在侧柜，让桌面留给材料。长发可以束起，完成作品后再一起整理桌面。

材料说明

课堂按当周主题准备鲜花、枝叶、花器、剪刀和固定材料。手套按每人一双准备，工作台旁有清洁用品。需要了解植物种类或对材料有特别顾虑，可以在报名时说明，花室会核对该次课程的采购安排。

工具在课堂开始时统一说明使用方式。桌边的小桶用于收集修剪下的枝叶，较长的枝条不要留在通道上。作品离开前会检查固定点，并附上适合这组花材的养护说明。

取消政策文案

开课前至少七天取消，可全额退还订金。距开课不足七天的申请，请回复报名确认信息，写明订单号、课程日期和人数，花室会按已确认的安排讨论后续处理。转让席位或更换参与人也需要提前告知。

团队课的人数、花器与场地准备会写在单独确认信息中。公开课程的空位不直接代表团队课可以接待的时间，安排好后再告知参与者到场细节。

课程之后

作品完成后，老师会解释保水、摆放和再次修剪的顺序。回家路上尽量避免花器倾倒；需要继续转乘公共交通，可以在下课前询问包装方式。想延伸练习时，可保留当次课程的养护卡，记下自己采用的花材组合。

婚礼与小型聚会

先讨论空间与人数

小型婚礼和家庭聚会的花艺，从场地、桌面尺寸与使用时间开始。请准备预计人数、场地照片和希望保留的色调。我们会讨论桌花高度、仪式区和取放路径，避免把作品放在会阻挡通行的位置。

场地勘察费按次收取，金额为 AUD 150。勘察安排与后续制作报价分别确认。需要场地方协助开门或提供尺寸时，请在确定日期前说明，让当天讨论留出足够时间。

花器租用

花器租用订金为 AUD 35。报价会列出数量、尺寸和归还日期，便于聚会结束后核对。花器需保持完整，归还前请倒净余水；如有破损，不要自行把碎片装回普通包装里，应先联系花室讨论安全的处理方式。

花材与花器的关系会影响整体比例。较长桌面不一定只需要一个更大的作品，也可以由多组小花器组合，给餐具和交谈留出空间。样品讨论不代替最终数量清单。

确认交付范围

制作前会确认作品数量、摆放位置、交付时间和谁负责接收。场地临时增加桌面或更改动线时，请通过原有联系渠道沟通，花室会说明能否调整、需要哪些材料以及费用变化。

活动当天如由亲友接收，提前提供对接人的姓名与可联系时段即可，不需要公开身份证件或个人付款资料。作品在指定地点交接后，现场后续摆放按已确认的服务范围处理。

Harbour Frame Collective

CollectivePeople and workshopsVisit and contactProgramme archive 2023

A shared place for making and conversation

Small workshops, open conversations

Harbour Frame Collective brings people together around drawing, print and simple bookmaking. Some visitors arrive with a project already in progress; others come for a first introduction to a material. We make time for questions and encourage people to take ideas in different directions.

Our current visitor address is Studio 4, 28 Sample Arcade, Northbridge WA 6003. The Visit page describes arrival and contact arrangements. Public programmes have their own dates and materials lists; a general enquiry starts a conversation rather than reserving a place.

What you can find here

  • Short introductions to the people running our sessions.
  • Practical notes for visiting the current studio.
  • A programme archive from earlier venues.

Session bookings and payments are handled separately after the programme arrangements are confirmed.

Working at a comfortable scale

We choose small groups so participants have room to work and speak with a facilitator. A session may begin with a shared demonstration, then move into individual work. People can ask to see a process again, compare materials and discuss ways to continue at home.

The collective keeps a small reference shelf with paper samples, books and tools used in earlier sessions. It supports conversation during a workshop rather than a retail catalogue. When a programme needs a specific purchase or contribution, its information sheet explains that arrangement.

Keep in touch

Use the contact form for a question about visiting, a group session or the materials listed for a programme. Including the session title helps us pass the question to the right facilitator. Please leave passwords, payment card numbers and identity documents out of general correspondence.

The 2023 programme archive records an earlier venue. For a current visit, use the studio address and arrangements on the Visit page rather than an address printed in an old programme.

files.team.html:
Skip to content

Harbour Frame Collective

CollectivePeople and workshopsVisit and contactProgramme archive 2023

People and workshop approaches

Meet the collective

Our facilitators come from illustration, printmaking and community arts. Each brings a different working rhythm: some sessions build around a repeated mark, others begin with a conversation about place or a small object. Participants do not need to use the same process as the person beside them.

Drawing from ordinary objects

A drawing session might start with one familiar object viewed from several positions. We discuss edges, negative space and how marks can suggest weight. The aim is to notice choices, not to produce identical pages. A facilitator can offer a short demonstration when a participant wants to try another approach.

Paper and basic drawing tools are listed with the programme. If a session permits personal materials, bring only what fits in your own working area. Keep wet materials and cutting tools away from someone else's paper, and ask before borrowing tools from another table.

Printed layers and simple books

Print sessions explore how a repeated shape changes when colour, pressure or orientation changes. Bookmaking sessions consider folding and sequence, with time to decide how one page leads to the next. We explain tools before they are used and make a clear space for drying or storing work during a break.

Participants who want to continue after a session can ask which tools are essential and which can be replaced with materials already at home. We describe our own approaches, while recognising that people may prefer different working methods.

Visit the current studio

Current address

Our current visitor address is Studio 4, 28 Sample Arcade, Northbridge WA 6003.

Check the information sent with your programme for arrival time and the studio entrance. A facilitator may be preparing materials before the session begins, so please wait in the shared reception area if the room is not ready. The corridor must stay clear for other arcade users.

Before you come

If you want information about steps, seating or the room layout, ask before the day of your visit. We can describe the space and discuss the arrangements available for that programme. You do not need to provide sensitive personal documents to ask an access question.

Bring the materials named in the programme notes and a bag large enough to carry your work home. Some pieces need time to dry, so a facilitator may suggest collecting them later. Please check before bringing food into a session that uses shared tools or delicate paper.

Contact the collective

For programme or visit questions, write to hello@harbourframe.example.org or use the form below. Include the title of a session if your question relates to a particular programme, along with a contact email where a facilitator can reply.

Earlier venues

The programme archive preserves descriptions and venue details from earlier years. Those pages are useful for remembering a programme, but current visits use the address on this page. A reference to a past venue does not reserve a place in a current session.

files.archive-2023.html:
Skip to content

Harbour Frame Collective

CollectivePeople and workshopsVisit and contactProgramme archive 2023

Programme archive 2023

Paper, place and shared observations

The 2023 programme brought drawing and simple print sessions to a temporary room near the river. Participants collected shapes from surrounding streets and used them to make folded sequences. The programme included an afternoon conversation about how a familiar route changes when it is recorded in marks rather than words.

2023 venue: Room 2, 9 Former Quay, East Perth WA 6004. These venue details belong to the 2023 programme. Current programmes use the Visit page for arrival information.

Drawing a route

Participants began with quick observations made on the way to the room: a repeating window frame, a branch above a gate, or a pattern on a footpath. At the table, those notes became a short sequence of marks. Some people chose a recognisable route; others rearranged the material into a more open story.

The conversation considered what gets left out when a place is drawn from memory. A facilitator offered examples of how a change in scale or rhythm can connect separate observations without turning the page into a map.

Layered postcards

The print session used simple shapes and a limited group of colours. Participants compared the effect of a lighter layer over a darker mark, then chose a sequence for a small set of postcards. The workshop allowed time to try variations before choosing which pages to keep together.

Work was displayed informally along one wall while participants talked about materials and process. Some took their pages home as a set; others folded or cut them into new arrangements after the session.
